# coval_test_case (Data Source)

Retrieves a Coval test case by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_test_case" "refund_policy" {
  id = "abc123def456ghi789jklm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Test-case ID.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Human-readable test-case description.
- `expected_behaviors` (List of String) Ordered behaviors expected from the agent.
- `expected_output_json` (Dynamic) Arbitrary JSON object containing the expected structured output.
- `input_str` (String) Scenario, transcript, or other input presented by this test case.
- `input_type` (String) Test-case input type.
- `metric_input` (Dynamic) Arbitrary JSON object containing metric input data.
- `name` (String) Canonical API resource name.
- `script_turns` (Dynamic) Ordered JSON array of persona turns used by SCRIPT test cases.
- `simulation_metadata_input` (Dynamic) Arbitrary JSON object containing simulation metadata.
- `test_set_id` (String) ID of the Coval test set containing this test case.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.
- `user_notes` (String) User-provided notes about the test case.
